checks.observed: The official @deepseek-ai/dsh Web profile served the standard DSH page and accepted the one-time root token exchange.

The current LocalConnectorAgentService + WebSocketConnectorClient completed a real WebSocket upgrade to /v1/connect, hello handshake and workspace registration; the CLI entrypoint uses these same components.
Authenticated /api/ohos-ar/overview returned HTTP 200 with workspace_mode=local_connector, workspace-1, device-8794 and connector.connected=true.
The official page received the live Connector catalog: Claude Code and Codex were connector_online/dispatchable; missing CLIs were reported explicitly as connector_agent_missing.

Authenticated preflight returned HTTP 200 and status=blocked, so the page did not queue P0 without a registered SSH Workspace Gateway, OHOS source layout, hdc/device and environment/publication evidence.
A deliberately incomplete POST /api/ohos-ar/runs returned HTTP 400 preflight_blocked with workspace/gateway/source/device reasons and queued no run.

scope_limits: This smoke used loopback HTTP and a temporary profile; production TLS/mTLS, pairing, external secrets, tenancy and capacity are deployment gates.
The official-page smoke used a local test root because the temporary loopback SSH fixture is exercised separately; the CLI rejects an SSHFS configuration without an SSH binding or verified mount.

The separate real-loopback SSH smoke proves remote_tools read/write, registered profile execution and artifact projection, but it does not replace a user's production SSH host, SSHFS mount, TLS/mTLS pairing or credential policy.
The current WSL host has no persistent sshfs/hdc, real OHOS product root or device, so a live P0-P8 build/device/publish run cannot be claimed from this host.

The deterministic Connector network test separately proves cloud WebSocket -> local CodeAgent -> workspace edit, usage and artifact projection: platform/apps/local-console/test/connector-codeagent-executor.test.js (6/6).
